description: For financial advisors (requires a MySSAgent advisor account — sign in with your myssagent.com advisor account when prompted). Re-runs the full MySSAgent engine for one of YOUR clients on the earnings record and household data already on file, then stores the refreshed results. Use after an engine update or when the advisor asks for fresh numbers. It cannot add a new client or ingest an SSA statement — new clients are provisioned in the advisor dashboard. Requires the advisor_client_id from list_clients. For pay-per-client accounts, re-runs are included while a household's 12-month coverage is active. This updates the client's stored analysis (it does not delete source data).

advisor_client_id.description: The client's id from list_clients (a UUID).

name: run_client_analysis
title: Re-run a client's claiming analysis
